HEADLINE: Kama Holdings Ltd-has informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve A meeting of the Board of Directors ....
MORE:
Kama Holdings Ltd-has informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve A meeting of the Board of Directors is scheduled to be held on Thursday, 5th November 2026 for inter-alia,
considering and approving the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th
September 2026.
Pursuant to the Code of Conduct to Regulate, Monitor and Report Trading by Insiders framed in accordance
with the Securities & Exchange Board of India (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, the
window for trading in the shares of the Company by the Designated Persons & Directors is closed between
Thursday, 01st October 2026 to Saturday, 07th November 2026 (both days inclusive).
